title: Fiber laser cutting machines
subtitle: Dener GFL with pallet changer and Smart fiber lasers with shuttle table or semi-closed · 5 × 10 to 13 × 82 ft · 3 to 40 kW
cover_line: Dener Makina · made in Turkey · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_title: Production fiber lasers from Turkey, from a 5 × 10 ft sheet to 13 × 82 ft plate
about_text: A fiber laser cutting machine cuts sheet and plate from a DXF file with a focused beam — mild steel to 3/4″ with 6 kW, 1″ with 12 kW and 1-1/2″ and beyond with 20 to 40 kW — at speeds no plasma or punch can match, with a clean edge and no tooling. Dener builds two sheet lasers: the GFL, the production machine with a stress-relieved frame, a space-frame gantry rated for 1.5 G and a pallet changer, in 5 × 10, 6.6 × 13 and 6.6 × 20 ft; and the Smart, the economy line from the same factory — with a shuttle table in six sizes from 5 × 10 to 8.5 × 41 ft, or semi-closed, with the cabin on the gantry over a single table from 8.2 × 20 to 13 × 82 ft for long plate. Fiber sources from 3 to 40 kW, Precitec or Raytools autofocus heads, nesting software and production reports on the control.

Dener Makina has built sheet-metal and laser machinery in Kayseri since 1974 and exports to more than 100 countries. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada — layout for your building, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts stocked in Canada.
